# Reading list {#sec-reading-list}

Every work cited in the book and in the API reference, grouped by topic.
Full entries are in the [References](../references.html).

## Textbooks and automatic differentiation

- @goodfellow2016deep: the standard textbook on deep learning.
- @rumelhart1986learning: backpropagation for training neural networks.
- @griewank2008evaluating: the theory of algorithmic differentiation,
  forward and reverse mode.
- @baydin2018automatic: a survey of automatic differentiation in machine
  learning.

## Optimization

- @sutskever2013importance: momentum and initialization in deep learning.
- @kingma2015adam: Adam.
- @loshchilov2019decoupled: decoupled weight decay (AdamW).
- @hinton2012lecture: RMSprop, introduced in lecture slides.
- @loshchilov2017sgdr: cosine learning-rate schedules with restarts.
- @goyal2017accurate: linear warm-up of the learning rate for large
  batches.
- @pascanu2013difficulty: exploding gradients and gradient-norm clipping.

## Initialization and activations

- @glorot2010understanding: Xavier/Glorot initialization.
- @he2015delving: Kaiming/He initialization for ReLU networks.
- @hendrycks2016gaussian: the GELU activation.

## Regularization and normalization

- @srivastava2014dropout: dropout.
- @ioffe2015batch: batch normalization.
- @ba2016layer: layer normalization.
- @szegedy2016rethinking: label smoothing.

## Generalization

- @zhang2017understanding: networks fit random labels.
- @belkin2019reconciling: double descent and the classical bias-variance
  trade-off.
- @nakkiran2020deep: double descent in deep networks.
- @bartlett2020benign: benign overfitting in linear regression.
- @rahimi2007random: random features for kernel machines.

## The neural tangent kernel

- @jacot2018neural: the neural tangent kernel.
- @lee2019wide: wide networks evolve as linear models.
- @chizat2019lazy: lazy training.

## Convolutions and sequences

- @lecun1998gradient: convolutional networks trained by gradient descent.
- @chellapilla2006high: convolutions as matrix products (im2col).
- @alipanahi2015predicting: convolutional networks for DNA- and
  RNA-binding specificities.
- @zhou2015predicting: predicting the effects of noncoding variants with
  deep learning.
- @leslie2002spectrum: the spectrum kernel.
- @leslie2004mismatch: the mismatch kernel.

## Attention and representations

- @vaswani2017attention: the transformer.
- @xiong2020layer: pre-LN against post-LN transformers.
- @hinton2006reducing: deep autoencoders.
- @bengio2013representation: a review of representation learning.
- @scholkopf1998nonlinear: kernel PCA.
- @bakir2003learning: pre-images in kernel methods.
- @rives2021biological: a protein language model (ESM-1b); structure and
  function emerge from unsupervised training on sequences.
- @lin2023evolutionary: ESM-2, the model of Colab notebook C.

## Software and numerical computing

- @harris2020array: NumPy.
- @paszke2019pytorch: PyTorch.
- @okuta2017cupy: CuPy.
- @dlpack: DLPack, the array-exchange format.
- @blanchard2021accurately: accurate log-sum-exp and softmax.
